about_the_game:
Rise beyond fortune-telling. Awaken the Oracle within.

In Tarot Awakening™, your journey is more than reading cards, it’s mastering destiny itself. Train your intuition through dynamic spreads, flashcards, memory games, and advanced challenges inspired by the timeless Rider–Waite Tarot. Every decision sharpens your insight. Every mistake draws you deeper into the mysteries.

Will you ascend to Oracle status... or lose yourself in the shifting tides of fate?

Features

  • Authentic Tarot Training: Master the Rider–Waite deck through guided spreads, intuitive reading exercises, and real-world layouts.

  • Memory & Intuition Challenges: Sharpen your mind with memory games, flip-to-reveal challenges, and symbolic associations.

  • Oracle Rank System: Rise from Wandering Novice to Supreme Oracle, your performance shapes your title.

  • Mystical Environments: Read in enchanted altars, unlock secret backgrounds, and feel the pull of sacred spaces.

  • Voice Guidance: Let immersive narration and subtle ambient sounds guide your journey.

  • Track Your Growth: Journal your insights, victories, and transformative moments along the way.

Tarot Awakening™ isn’t just a game — it’s a calling.
Unlock the wisdom of the ancients. Challenge your mind. Trust your spirit.

The deck awaits you.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS 10.7
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with at least 512MB Shared VRAM & openGL 2.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Mac-compatible sound card

  • OS: Mac OS 11.0
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with at least 512MB Shared VRAM & openGL 2.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Mac-compatible sound card
